name: The Faith Militant
about: A barefoot preacher says the crown has no gods, and the poor believe him. A pious lord gives him a hall, then guards, then an army. Win the faith over, break it, or bow to it.
title: The Faith Militant

beats.speaker: skeptic
beats.text: A barefoot preacher walks the roads around {temple}, saying the crown has forgotten the gods, and the gods won't forget the crown. Thousands follow him. {patron} gives him a hall.

court.text: {skeptic} of {skeptic.house}: "A ragged holy man is preaching against your crown under {patron}'s roof, Your Grace. Shall I quietly move him on?"

options.label: Pay for the temple at {temple} and listen to him (200 gold)
options.result: The King's gold rebuilds the temple at {temple}. The preacher blesses the crown, once, and not gladly.

options.label: Have the preacher silenced
options.result: The preacher is taken in the night. By morning three others are preaching in his place.

options.label: Let him preach
options.hint: Nothing happens now, but the faith grows
options.result: The King lets him preach. His crowds grow every holy day.

beats.speaker: patron
beats.text: The faithful take up arms. They call themselves the Swords of the Faith, sworn to the preacher and fed by {patron}. They hang a tax collector at {temple}'s gate.

court.text: {skeptic}: "Armed zealots are hanging your officers now, Your Grace, and {patron} pays for their bread. Either they lose or you do."

options.label: Give the Faith its own courts, and break up the Swords
options.result: The Faith gets its courts, and most of the Swords lay down their arms.

options.label: Order {patron} to disarm them, or be outlawed
options.result: The King's order reaches {temple}. {patron} reads it to the Swords and asks what they think.

beats.speaker: patron
beats.text: The preacher crowns {patron} King by the will of the gods, and the Swords of the Faith march on Kingsmere, singing.

beats.speaker: patron
beats.text: The faith and the crown make peace. The preacher dies old, in a temple the King built, and is made a saint.

beats.speaker: skeptic
beats.text: The Swords of the Faith are beaten and their banners burned. The faithful go back to praying, for now, and for a different King.
